name: Ariel Tabak Outside Passing System
description: A companion to Ariel Tabak’s Outside Passing Compendium, emphasizing outside-pass finishes, leg traps and the course’s explicit gi-grip material.
summary: Follow Ariel Tabak’s outside-passing study from getting around the legs to the problem of finishing with upper-body control.
overview: Outside Passing Compendium by Ariel Tabak separates getting outside the legs from progressing afterward. It suits a passer who reaches the flank but still has questions about finishing. Its later grip-specific chapters also make equipment choice part of selecting a study route.

flashcards.question: Why should a no-gi reader separate the grip-specific sections of Ariel Tabak’s Outside Passing Compendium?
flashcards.answer: The published outline names collar, pant and sleeve grips. Those sections assume gi equipment and cannot be treated as unchanged no-gi sequences.

products.blurb: Follow Ariel Tabak’s outside-passing study from getting around the legs to the problem of finishing with upper-body control.
products.best_for: You get outside the legs but need a focused study of the remaining finishing problems.

guide.display_title: Ariel Tabak: Outside Passing and Finishing

fits: You get outside the legs but need a focused study of the remaining finishing problems.
consider_alternative_if: For a pass organized around a torso connection, compare Lachlan Giles’s The Body Lock Pass.

includes: Getting outside the legs, high-pummel responses and switching sides.
Leg traps with collar-and-pant or hip-and-pant grips, plus several finishing options.
limits: Several later sections explicitly use gi grips; no-gi readers should distinguish these from the earlier outside-position topics.

start_here.title: Find the gap between flanking and finishing
start_here.task: Compare the free outline’s Volume 1 chapters on getting outside the legs, progressing afterward, and reaching upper-body control. Place your last stalled attempt at one of those points. If you own the course, use the progression chapter as your first viewing target and record what new control it asks you to recognize.
start_here.section: Volume 1: Progressing After Getting Outside The Legs (18:33–24:09).
